drg.description: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease without CC/MCC

notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed. 70-year-old female admitted for COPD exacerbation. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.55, creatinine 0.78, hemoglobin 13, platelets 312, sodium 140, wbc 6.2; vitals dbp 74-78, heart_rate 81-85, map 89-94, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 17-18, sbp 119-126, spo2 97-98, temp 36.9-37.2
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Albuterol-ipratropium nebulizer; Prednisone 40 mg PO
Assessment and plan: COPD exacerbation.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 0.79, hemoglobin 13, platelets 318, sodium 140, wbc 5.9; vitals dbp 74-77, heart_rate 80-84, map 89-93, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 16-18, sbp 119-124, spo2 96-98, temp 36.9-37.1
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Albuterol-ipratropium nebulizer; Prednisone 40 mg PO
Assessment and plan: COPD exacerbation. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 70-year-old female, length of stay 2 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: COPD exacerbation. Follow up with primary care in one week. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed.
